## What Counts as a Test Run?​

Each`E2eRun` execution counts as one test run. A test run is a single browser session executing your test steps.

Examples:

- Running one test suite with 5 test cases = 5 test runs
- Re-running a failed test = 1 additional test run
- Running the same test on 3 browsers = 3 test runs

Test runs reset monthly on your billing date.
